Description: Vaccination of susceptible humans at rate u.
Waning vaccine protection causing vaccinated humans to return to susceptibility at rate theta.
Loss of natural immunity (waning immunity) returning recovered humans to susceptibility at rate delta.

Name: A
Description: Recruitment rate of humans (newborns entering the susceptible class).

Name: beta
Description: Probability/rate of successful primary infection from susceptible to infected through contact with infected individuals.

Name: epsilon
Description: Correction parameter for reinfection; reinfection probability is smaller than primary infection.

Name: u
Description: Rate of vaccination of susceptible individuals.

Name: theta
Description: Rate of vaccine waning from vaccinated back to susceptible.

Name: delta
Description: Dropout rate due to waning immunity from recovered back to susceptible.

Name: mu
Description: Natural death rate affecting all compartments.

Name: Rc
Description: Control reproduction number of the dimensionless system.
